scenes.caption: Rain!
scenes.say: It is raining hard. Zainab needs the right things to wear.

scenes.caption: Rubber boots.
scenes.say: Her boots are rubber. Rubber is waterproof, so her feet stay dry.

scenes.caption: A plastic coat.
scenes.say: Her raincoat is plastic. It is bendy and keeps the rain out.

scenes.caption: A paper hat?
scenes.say: Hamza wears a paper hat. It goes soggy! Paper is not waterproof.

scenes.caption: See-through glass.
scenes.say: At home, a glass window lets in light. We can see through it.

scenes.caption: Soft and hard.
scenes.say: A woolly jumper is soft. A wooden spoon is hard.

scenes.caption: Squash and stretch.
scenes.say: She squashes a sponge and stretches a rubber band.

scenes.caption: Warm and dry.
scenes.say: Alhamdulillah, Zainab is warm and dry. The right material for the job!
